text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has been struggling from<n>exhaustion,
so I bring her to the<n>infirmary to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get me some good ol'<n>shut-eye. Nnh...
Sooo sleepy...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What in tarnation?! Where am I?!<n>Wait... Aren't
those the Three<n>Goddesses?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's a real pleasure to meet<n>y'all! Would ya
mind if I got a hug?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aw, no need to be bashful! Don't<n>y'all just have
the cutest little<n>faces?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's all be good friends! How 'bout<n>joinin' me for
a party tonight?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Three Goddesses appear to<n>smile upon
hearing Taiki's words. At<n>that moment, a bright light
floods the<n>room.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, where did those Three<n>Goddesses get off to? I
was just<n>huggin' them, and then...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's a darn shame. It was such a<n>good dream,
too. But maybe this<n>means something real lucky is
fixin'<n>to happen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Back to her cheery self, Taiki Shuttle<n>leaves the
infirmary with a spring in<n>her step—perhaps the
work of the<n>Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's voice doesn't seem to reach<n>the ears of the
Three Goddesses, and<n>they depart. At that moment,
a bright<n>light floods the room.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was tryin' to hug some folks in my<n>dream, but
they up and vanished on<n>me! Just like magic!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Think I can meet 'em again if Igo back to sleep? Let me just shutmy eyes for a spell...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's excitement continues<n>unabated for
quite a while. Unable to<n>fall asleep, she doesn't get
the rest<n>she needs.
